targets:
  # Public DNS Servers (IPv4)
  - hosts:
      - 1.1.1.1              # Cloudflare Primary
      - 1.0.0.1              # Cloudflare Secondary
      - 8.8.8.8              # Google Primary
      - 8.8.4.4              # Google Secondary
      - 9.9.9.9              # Quad9 Primary
      # 149.112.112.112 is used for WAN2 gateway monitoring in OPNsense
    interval: 1s
    network: ip4
    protocol: icmp
    size: 56

  # Internet Services
  - hosts:
      - google.com
      - github.com
      - cnn.com
      - ghcr.io
    interval: 1s
    network: ip4
    protocol: icmp
    size: 56
Welcome to Mailu, your new email service. Please change your password and update your profile.

# Skip chown on mounted volumes, only run on /app
echo "Starting Mydia (skipping chown on mounted volumes)..."
mkdir -p /config /data /media 2>/dev/null || true
chown -R 1000:1000 /app 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -n "$TZ" ] && [ -f "/usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ" ]; then
  ln -sf "/usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ" /etc/localtime
fi
exec /app/bin/mydia start

cd /app
pip install --no-cache-dir --target /tmp/packages -r requirements.txt
export PYTHONPATH="/tmp/packages:$PYTHONPATH"
python app.py
